headline: On October 9, 1962: Uganda becomes an independent Commonwealth realm
captionCards: Lake Victoria shared with Kenya and Tanzania
instagramCaption:
Uganda officially became an independent Commonwealth realm on October 9, 1962. This landlocked East African nation shares borders with Kenya, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda, and Tanzania. The southern region features a substantial portion of Lake Victoria, which is shared with neighboring countries. As of 2024, the country supports a population of 45.9 million people. Kampala remains the capital and largest city, home to 1.8 million residents. How does this historical independence shape modern East African politics? Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
